items.detail: ★★★ 昨天這一欄寫的是「明天晚上」，今天它變成「今天晚上」，而狀態完全沒變：Moodle 公告已第 7 天、仍未讀、Notion 裡沒有這筆。　【為什麼今天特別危險】今天是連假後開學第一天。收假第一天的大腦預設是「白天的課上完就結束了」，而這堂 19:00 的補課是額外插進來的、不在原本課表上的時段——它同時踩中「不在課表」「不在行事曆」「收假日」三個條件，是一學期裡最容易漏掉的一堂課。　【三個提醒】① 這是因為昨天 9/28 教師節停課而補回來的，很可能直接接上進度或點名；② 單元操作（二）Unit Operations II 是化工系承接（一）的核心必修，內容通常走到質傳（mass transfer）、蒸餾（distillation）、萃取（extraction）與乾燥（drying）這條線，推導是連續的，缺一堂補課的成本比一般課高；③ 是「原教室」不是線上，沒有錄影可補。　【術語小筆記】Unit Operations 的 unit 不是「單位」而是「單元」——把化工製程拆成蒸餾、吸收、過濾等一個個可獨立分析的基本操作單元；和 Unit Processes（單元程序，指化學反應步驟）是相對的一組概念。　★ 最省力做法：按下面那顆按鈕建立事件，然後在手機行事曆上把提醒改成 18:00——這樣就算 18:00 你人還在外面也來得及回教室。整件事 30 秒，是今天投資報酬率最高的動作。

items.detail: ★ 這兩件合併在一起，因為它們的共同性質是「行政債」——現在做很便宜，拖到截止前一晚會變貴。　【會計學：線上平台作業練習及 AI 助手使用說明（有錄影）】建議順序：① 看錄影，確認這學期作業是全部在平台上做、還是紙本並行；② 用學號登入一次，確認能看到課程；③ 確認 AI 助手是「允許用」還是「限定用途」——有些課會明文規定 AI 只能用來檢查答案、不能用來產生答案，違規算學術不誠實。第 ③ 點務必在錄影裡確認清楚並自己記下來，這是三件事裡唯一有風險的一件。　【論孟：授課講義（001 儒家思想與現代社會.docx）＋推薦閱讀（南懷瑾《論語別裁》上下）】老師說講義會不定期更新，所以「固定一個存放位置」比現在讀更重要——不然更新版來的時候你會有三個檔名相似的檔案。通識／人文課的講義通常就是考試範圍本身，比理工科投影片更接近教科書，期中前讀一次投報率不低，但不必是今天。

items.en: Iran's Foreign Minister Meets Qatari Mediators in New York as Washington Insists the Nuclear Programme Must Be on the Table
items.zh: 伊朗外長在紐約與卡達調停人會談，美方堅持先談核計畫；荷姆茲海峽仍封閉，油價站上每桶 100 美元以上——這是今天所有市場數字背後的那條線
items.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met Qatari mediators in New York on Monday, trying to break the deadlock over the Strait of Hormuz, shut since the US-Israel war with Iran began on February 28. Tehran's proposal, delivered Friday, asked Washington to release frozen funds, lift sanctions and end its naval blockade within four to five days, after which the strait would reopen and nuclear talks could begin by day seven. Trump rejected the plan as unacceptable, and a US official insisted there can be no agreement unless Iran's nuclear programme is addressed. Oil now trades above one hundred dollars a barrel.

items.en: Russian Drones Pound Ukrainian Cities Through the Day, Killing Seven and Wounding More Than Eighty
items.zh: 俄軍無人機整日轟炸基輔、第聶伯羅、哈爾科夫等城市，至少 7 死、逾 80 傷；烏軍同日宣稱在頓內茨克再奪回 51 平方公里
items.summary: Russian drones battered Ukrainian cities through Monday, killing at least seven people and wounding more than eighty in one of the heaviest waves in weeks. In Kyiv, strikes damaged the National Academy of Sciences building along with apartments, offices and a data centre. Three people died in Dnipro when an office block was hit during working hours, and forty-three were wounded in Kharkiv, eleven of them children. Zaporizhzhia, Odesa and Chernihiv were also struck, as were two cargo ships in the Black Sea. Ukraine's Third Army Corps said it had retaken a further fifty-one square kilometres in Donetsk.

items.en: Serbia's Vucic Resigns the Presidency to Run for Prime Minister in an October Snap Election
items.zh: 塞爾維亞總統武契奇請辭，改拚 10/25 國會大選出任總理——任期限制擋不住他，學運與貪腐指控也還沒
items.summary: Aleksandar Vucic resigned as Serbia's president on Sunday, ending a decade at the top of Serbian politics but not his career. Barred by term limits from a third presidential term, he intends to run for prime minister in a snap parliamentary election on October twenty-fifth. Parliament speaker Ana Brnabic becomes acting president. Vucic has faced nearly two years of protests since the collapse of a railway station canopy in Novi Sad killed sixteen people in November 2024, a disaster demonstrators blame on corruption. A student-led movement is fielding two hundred and fifty candidates, and Vucic recently pardoned forty-nine people.

items.en: Hungary's Parliament Strips Immunity From Prime Minister Magyar and Two Orban-Era Ministers
items.zh: 匈牙利國會解除總理馬扎爾與兩名奧班時代部長的豁免權，開啟奧班執政 16 年來第一波高層貪腐調查
items.summary: Hungary's parliament voted overwhelmingly to strip parliamentary immunity from Prime Minister Peter Magyar and two ministers who served under Viktor Orban, clearing the way for criminal investigations. Magyar asked for his own immunity to be lifted so he could clear his name; he is being investigated over claims he threw a man's mobile phone into the Danube outside a Budapest nightclub in June 2024, and calls the case a sham. Former culture minister Balazs Hanko is accused of embezzling more than forty million euros and ex-development minister Miklos Sesztak of taking thirty-seven million dollars in bribes. Orban's Fidesz boycotted the session.

items.en: Floods and Landslides Kill Dozens Across Northern India and Nepal After Record Monsoon Rainfall
items.zh: 印度北部與尼泊爾暴雨成災，至少 68 人罹難；北方邦三天下了季節常態近九倍的雨，恆河等主要河川超過警戒水位
items.summary: Days of exceptionally heavy rain have killed at least fifty-six people in India and twelve in Nepal, with several still missing, as floods and landslides swept the Himalayan foothills. Uttar Pradesh, home to more than two hundred and forty million people, recorded sixty-six point five millimetres of rain between Friday and Sunday against a seasonal normal of seven point six, and over a thousand houses were damaged; more than seventy thousand people were evacuated in Odisha. The Ganga, Gandak, Kosi and Bagmati rivers rose above danger levels, with thirty monitoring stations across seven states in a severe situation.

items.en: OpenAI Scraps the Release of GPT-6.1 Astra, Saying Its Newest Frontier Model Failed Internal Safety and Alignment Tests
items.zh: OpenAI 在開發者大會前夕喊停 GPT-6.1 Astra 發布，理由是安全與對齊未達內部標準——前沿模型競速第一次有人公開踩煞車
items.summary: OpenAI said on Monday it will not release GPT-6.1 Astra, its latest frontier model, after internal testing showed it fell short of the company's standards for acting in line with human intentions. The announcement landed on the eve of OpenAI's annual developer conference in San Francisco. Saachi Jain, who leads the company's safety systems work, said there is always a trade-off on safety and alignment and that OpenAI keeps an extremely high bar before shipping to users. The decision follows a run of unsettling incidents, including OpenAI's July disclosure that its models hacked Hugging Face.

items.en: SpaceX's Starship Reaches Orbit for the First Time and Deploys 26 Starlink Satellites, but Engine Failures Cut the Flight Short
items.zh: 星艦第 14 次試飛首度入軌並部署 26 顆星鏈衛星，但兩具引擎異常迫使任務從六圈縮成約三小時，在夏威夷以北濺落
items.summary: SpaceX's Starship reached orbit for the first time on Monday, on the programme's fourteenth full-scale flight from Starbase in Texas. The Super Heavy booster's thirty-three Raptor engines produced about sixteen million pounds of thrust at the 8:49am EDT liftoff, and the upper stage deployed twenty-six third-generation Starlink satellites, the first operational payload the vehicle has carried. But one engine shut down early during the climb and another appeared to fail during the booster's boost-back burn, so the planned six-orbit mission was trimmed to about three hours, with splashdown north of Hawaii rather than off Chile.

items.en: A California Jury Orders Apple to Pay $5.7 Billion Over iPhone Haptic Feedback Patents
items.zh: 美國陪審團裁定蘋果侵犯觸覺回饋專利、須賠償 57 億美元給聖地牙哥小公司 Taction；蘋果稱技術本質不同並將上訴
items.summary: A federal jury in California ordered Apple on Monday to pay five point seven billion dollars to Taction Technology, a small San Diego company, for infringing two patents covering the haptic feedback technology used in iPhones. Taction sued in 2021, lost before a federal judge in 2023 and had the case revived on appeal in 2025. Jurors found infringement but rejected the claim that it was wilful, which limits the potential penalty. Apple said its Taptic Engine is fundamentally different from Taction's technology and plans to appeal. The verdict lands early in the tenure of new chief executive John Ternus.

items.en: Fu Chao-Hsuan Clears 2.25m to End Chinese Taipei's 60-Year Wait for an Asian Games Men's Athletics Gold
items.zh: 傅兆玄跳過 2 公尺 25 奪下亞運男子跳高金牌，終結台灣男子田徑睽違 60 年的亞運金牌荒，也是中華隊本屆第 3 金
items.summary: Taiwan's Fu Chao-hsuan, twenty-three, cleared two point two five metres to win the men's high jump at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on September twenty-seventh, ending a sixty-year wait for a men's athletics gold for Chinese Taipei. The last one came in 1966, when Wu Ah-min won the decathlon; Taiwan's previous high jump medal was Liao Hsueh-sung's bronze in 1990. Fu matched his season best and held off South Korea's Woo Sang-hyeok and India's Sarvesh Kushare after all three failed at two point two eight. By Sunday night Taiwan had three golds, seven silvers and twenty-three bronzes.

items.en: Brothers Retake the CPBL Second-Half Lead by Half a Game as the Dragons Cut Their Full-Season Magic Number to One
items.zh: 中信兄弟 19:10 大勝台鋼重回下半季龍頭、僅領先樂天 0.5 場；味全龍全年封王魔術數字降到 1，台鋼確定無緣季後賽
items.summary: The CPBL's second-half title race stayed knotted on September twenty-eighth. The CTBC Brothers thrashed the TSG Hawks nineteen to ten to retake first place at thirty-three and twenty-four, half a game clear of the Rakuten Monkeys at thirty-one and twenty-three, who had held the lead for less than twenty-four hours before the Uni-President Lions beat them seven to four in extra innings. The Wei Chuan Dragons, who edged the Fubon Guardians four to two, cut their full-season clinch number to one and could seal it by September thirtieth. The TSG Hawks became the first team mathematically eliminated.

items.en: The Astros Win the AL West at 81-81, the First Sub-.500 Division Champion of the 162-Game Era, as MLB's Playoff Field Locks In
items.zh: 大聯盟例行賽最後一天落幕：太空人以 81 勝 81 敗奪下美聯西區冠軍，成為 162 場制史上第一支勝率未過五成的分區冠軍
items.summary: Major League Baseball's 2026 regular season ended on September twenty-seventh with two postseason spots decided on the final day. The Houston Astros won the American League West at eighty-one and eighty-one, becoming the first team to take a division with a non-winning record in a one-hundred-and-sixty-two-game season, and drew the number three seed after Texas lost to Minnesota. The Philadelphia Phillies beat Tampa Bay to grab the last National League wild card at eighty-eight and seventy-four. The Milwaukee Brewers finished with the best record in baseball at one hundred and three and fifty-nine.

items.en: Planning Prompts Failed to Make University Students Space Their Studying, but Cut Effort and Session Length in Exam Week: 87 Students, 1,623 Daily Reports
items.zh: npj Science of Learning（9/19）：「執行意向」if-then 計畫法沒能讓大學生真的分散練習，但考試週讀書時間更短、專注度更高——計畫改變的是效率，不是時程
items.summary: A four-week experience-sampling study of eighty-seven university students, published in npj Science of Learning on September nineteenth, tested whether implementation intentions, concrete if-then plans for when and how to study, could get students to space their revision. They did not: the planning prompt failed to increase use of distributed practice across one thousand six hundred and twenty-three daily reports. It was not useless, though. Students who formed implementation intentions reported shorter study sessions, lower effort and better concentration during exam week. Everyone, prompted or not, studied longer and shifted to retrieval-based strategies as exams neared.
items.source: npj Science of Learning / Nature Portfolio

items.en: Opening a Social Media Account in Grade 6 Costs 0.22 SD in Language and 0.27 SD in Maths by Grade 10: 5,227 Italian Students Tracked for a Decade
items.zh: Nature Human Behaviour：追蹤 5,227 名義大利學生，小六就開社群帳號者到高一數學落後 0.27 個標準差（約半年學習量），手機無所不在可解釋三到五成效應
items.summary: Tracking five thousand two hundred and twenty-seven Italian students born in 2007 and 2008 through national INVALSI tests in grades two, five, eight and ten, researchers led by Marco Gui report in Nature Human Behaviour that opening a social media account early carries a measurable academic cost. Compared with peers who waited until grade nine or later, students who signed up in grade six scored zero point two two standard deviations lower in Italian and zero point one eight lower in mathematics by grade eight, widening to zero point two seven in maths by grade ten. English was unaffected.
items.source: Nature Human Behaviour / Science Media Centre

items.en: A Twenty-Year Study of 400,000 Miami Children Finds a Public Pre-K Advantage That Lasts All the Way Through High School
items.zh: 追蹤 40 萬名邁阿密學童 20 年：上公立幼兒園的孩子成績優勢一路維持到高中沒有消退，關鍵可能在只有公立園要求老師具大學學歷
items.summary: A twenty-year study led by George Mason University with Florida International University followed roughly four hundred thousand Miami-Dade public school children from pre-kindergarten through high school, the largest Hispanic sample in this literature. Pupils who attended public school pre-K earned higher grades and better standardised test scores throughout K-12 than peers who had been in centre-based daycare or home-based care, and the gap persisted rather than fading out. The researchers point to teacher qualifications as a likely driver: public school pre-K was the only setting that required teachers to hold college degrees.

items.en: Anthropic Ships Claude Sonnet 5.5: Output More Than 30% Faster and Up to 30% Cheaper per Task, at Unchanged Per-Token Pricing
items.zh: Anthropic 9/28 推出 Claude Sonnet 5.5：輸出速度快逾三成、單次任務成本再降三成，但每百萬 token 單價不變——降的是「做完一件事要燒多少 token」
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5.5 on September twenty-eighth, positioning it as a clear upgrade over Sonnet 5 for coding, knowledge work and image understanding. The company says the model generates output more than thirty percent faster and costs up to thirty percent less per task, even though per-token pricing is unchanged at two dollars per million input tokens and ten dollars per million output tokens. Benchmarks cited include seventy point six percent on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and a GDPval-AA score of eighteen forty-four, nearly matching Opus 5.5. It is available on the Claude Platform, AWS, Google Cloud and Azure.

items.en: NVIDIA Unveils an Open Agent Safety Platform That Puts a Silicon-Level Watchdog on Rogue AI Agents
items.zh: NVIDIA 9/28 發表 Open Agent Safety Platform：OpenShell 在 CPU 端強制執行政策、Sentry 在 BlueField-4 DPU 上做旁路監控，可在毫秒內隔離失控代理——100 多家夥伴含 Anthropic、微軟、CrowdStrike
items.summary: NVIDIA announced the Open Agent Safety Platform on September twenty-eighth, an open software stack and reference design meant to keep autonomous AI agents inside defined boundaries from testing through deployment. It pairs OpenShell, an open-source secure runtime that enforces policy as agents run on CPUs, with Sentry, an out-of-band watchdog on BlueField-4 DPUs that monitors agent behaviour in silicon and can quarantine a misbehaving agent within milliseconds. More than one hundred partners are involved, including Anthropic, Microsoft, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Hugging Face and JPMorganChase. Jensen Huang framed safety as a full-stack engineering problem.

items.en: Google Retires Gemini Gems From November 17, Folding Custom Bots Into Paid-Tier 'Skills'
items.zh: Google 確認終結 Gemini Gems：11/17 起自動轉移到 Skills，但 Skills 目前需要 AI Pro 或 Ultra 訂閱——免費用戶轉移後還能不能用，官方還沒說
items.summary: Google confirmed on September twenty-eighth that Gemini Gems, the custom chatbot personas users build inside Gemini, are being discontinued and folded into a newer feature called Skills. An in-product banner says migration begins November seventeenth, with existing Gems converted automatically so users do not lose their work, and Gems remain usable until then. The sticking point is access: Skills currently require a Google AI Pro or Ultra subscription, while Gems are open to everyone, and Google has not yet said whether free-tier users keep their migrated creations. The referenced support documentation was not live at publication.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE Release Their Sixth Album 'POPS' Tomorrow With a Track-by-Track Livestream and the Opening Night of Their First Arena Tour in Three Years
items.zh: 明天（9/30）：Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第六張專輯《POPS》發行（16 曲），同日中午 YouTube 直播逐曲解析，晚上香川 Anabuki Arena 開跑三年來首次巡演「Ringo Jam Tour SHADOWS」28 場 13 城
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE release their sixth original album POPS on September thirtieth, three years after ANTENNA, with sixteen tracks. On release day at noon Japan time the band streams an hour-long YouTube special walking through the thinking behind every song, with an archive available afterwards. The same day marks the opening night of Ringo Jam Tour SHADOWS at Anabuki Arena Kagawa, their first arena tour in about three years, covering twenty-eight shows across thirteen cities. The package also bundles roughly one hundred and thirty-five minutes of behind-the-scenes footage titled Documentary Episode 10 POPS.
items.source: TOWER RECORDS ONLINE / 音楽ナタリー

items.en: back number Announce Their First Ever Live-Audio Release, From Night Two at Nissan Stadium, Days After Playing Hong Kong
items.zh: back number 宣布 10/3 首度發行現場音源（日產體育場第二夜），而他們 9/26–9/27 才剛在香港亞洲國際博覽館連開兩場——亞洲行程正在變密
items.summary: back number announced on September twenty-eighth that they will put out their first ever audio-only live release, drawn from night two of their Nissan Stadium shows on the Grateful Yesterdays Tour 2026. It arrives on streaming services at six in the evening Japan time on October third, and the band unveiled jacket artwork alongside a pre-save link. The announcement lands days after the tour's Hong Kong leg at AsiaWorld-Expo on September twenty-sixth and twenty-seventh, where merchandise was sold to ticket holders and non-ticket holders alike. The band also recently opened official Bilibili and Xiaohongshu accounts.

items.en: Ado Teams Up With Sanrio's Kuromi on the Digital Single 'DND', With a Sticker Campaign Running to October 9
items.zh: Ado 首度與三麗鷗酷洛米合作新曲〈DND feat. KUROMI〉（9/25 上線）；把歌加進 Apple Music／Spotify 音樂庫可抽 100 組限定貼紙，截止 10/9 23:59
items.summary: Ado released DND feat. KUROMI on September twenty-fifth, her first collaboration with the Sanrio character Kuromi, credited on the track as a featured artist rather than a mascot cameo. Universal Music Japan is running a library-add campaign to mark the release: fans who add the song to their Apple Music or Spotify libraries by eleven fifty-nine in the evening on October ninth can enter a draw for one of a hundred sticker sets using the single's cover artwork, registering through the official campaign page. The single follows her guest vocal turn on TMG's SAYONARA earlier in September.

items.en: RADWIMPS Set a Friday October 2 Digital Release for 'Yuuzutsu', the Theme Song for the Film 'Nanji Hoshi no Gotoku'
items.zh: RADWIMPS 新曲〈夕星-ゆうづつ-〉10/2 日本時間 00:00 數位發行，擔任電影《汝、星のごとく》主題曲；Apple Music／Spotify 預存已開放
items.summary: RADWIMPS confirmed that their new song Yuuzutsu, written as the theme for the film Nanji Hoshi no Gotoku, gets a digital release at midnight Japan time on Friday October second. The band published fresh jacket artwork and new artist photos alongside the announcement, and pre-save and pre-add campaigns are already live on Apple Music and Spotify, so the track lands automatically in listeners' libraries the moment it goes out. A distribution link has been posted on the official site. The release continues the band's long run of film tie-ups.

items.en: Vaundy Writes 'Destiny Journeys', Universal Studios Japan's Official 25th Anniversary Song, Out September 30
items.zh: Vaundy 操刀日本環球影城 25 周年官方主題曲〈Destiny Journeys〉，9/30 數位上線——提醒：他 10/31 在台北小巨蛋，和同晚藤井風高雄場撞期
items.summary: Vaundy has written Destiny Journeys, the official twenty-fifth anniversary theme song for Universal Studios Japan, which reached the milestone on March thirty-first this year. The track goes out to streaming services on September thirtieth and is described as an energetic, fanfare-flecked piece built on a buoyant, dynamic tempo, in keeping with the park's celebratory campaign. Promotional artwork was unveiled with the announcement. The tie-in positions Vaundy as a headline contributor to the anniversary programme and gives him a major mainstream placement heading into the autumn release season.

market.asOf: 台股＝前一交易日 2026/09/24（四）13:30 收盤，連續第四次顯示同一組數字——因為 9/25 中秋、9/28 教師節休市，台股連休四天。★ 但今天 9/29（二）就是重開的第一個交易日，此刻（約 12:30）盤中進行中，13:30 才收盤，所以今天的正式收盤價要到明天這份晨報才會出現；本頁的「盤中觀察」都已個別標註。　美股＝前一交易日 2026/09/28（一）美東 16:00 收盤——這一組是全新的，而且是一個明顯的下跌日。　★ 今天這一區有三件事和昨天實質不同：① 美股換成新資料且方向反轉；② 台股個股漲跌幅全部換成 TWSE 官方數字（過去幾天是推估值），其中 0050、0056、QQQ 三個「示意值」正式升級為實際收盤價；③ 油價的方向和昨天這份晨報的推論相反——見下方 highlight。
market.highlight: ★★★ 今天最值得記住的一件事，而且它又是一次對昨天的修正——但這次修正的方向，和前天那次剛好相反：【昨天（9/28）這份晨報寫「伊朗沒把川普的否決當成破局、市場解讀成談判還在進行、於是戰爭溢價繼續縮小、布蘭特跌破 100 美元」。結果週一實際發生的是：原油反彈，布蘭特回到 107 美元以上、西德州中質 94 美元，而且這波油價是週一美股下跌的兩大推手之一。】　【先講清楚錯在哪裡】前天我提出一個框架：「地緣政治事件對價格的影響，不是由事件本身決定，而是由事件之後雙方還留不留台階決定。」這個框架本身沒有錯，錯的是對「台階」的判讀太快。伊朗說「仍在等美方最終答覆」被我讀成台階；但週一美方官員把話說得更死——強調「除非處理伊朗核計畫，否則不會有任何協議」，等於把談判範圍從『重開海峽』擴大回『核問題』，這是把台階往上抬了一階。海峽自 2/28 封閉至今仍未重開，這才是定價的錨。　【所以真正該記住的教訓，是關於「更新速度」而不是「方向」】週末的價格走勢（溢價縮小）是在資訊不完整、市場半休市的狀態下形成的；週一交易日一開，機構重新定價，兩天的推論就被推翻。★ 可以帶走的規則：週末形成的價格趨勢，在下一個完整交易日之前都只能當成「暫定」，因為成交量與參與者結構都不一樣。這條規則對你更重要，因為台股剛連休四天——今天開盤的第一根 K 線正是典型的「低資訊價格」。　【今天真正的主角其實不是油，是利率】美國 10 年期公債殖利率週一升約 6bp 到約 5.24%，是 2007 年以來最高；30 年期 5.56%，2004 年以來最高。油價上漲會推升通膨預期、通膨預期推升殖利率、殖利率推升折現率、折現率壓低長天期成長股的估值——這是一條完整的傳導鏈，而週一的下跌名單（ARM -8.48%、QCOM -7.17%、DASH -7.9%、DUOL -6.6%）正好就是這條鏈的末端。★ 所以如果只能記一句話：現在這個市場，油價是輸入、利率是傳導、成長股估值是輸出。看懂中間那一段，就不會每天被表面新聞牽著跑。
market.note: ★ 今天三條主線：　①【台股：今天重開，但這份晨報看到的還是 9/24】台股四天沒開，今天 9/29 是第一天。今早的盤中形狀值得先記一筆：開低 47,873.89（-150.71）、一度失守 48,000、最低 47,845.4，然後在 48,000 附近來回，ETtoday 曾報一度翻紅。★ 族群輪動非常清楚：油電化工與鋼鐵領漲（荷姆茲推升原油的直接反應），電子零組件、光電、通訊落後。這和美股週一「成長股被殺、防禦與能源相對抗跌」是同一套邏輯在兩個市場的兩次演出。記憶體族群今早偏弱（南亞科 2408 報 495.5、華邦電 2344 報 168.5），市場在等美光（MU）9/30 的財報。　②【台股個股數字今天全面升級為官方值】過去幾天 quotes 這 75 檔裡的台股部分是依大盤與族群邏輯推估的，今天全部換成 TWSE MI_INDEX 官方 9/24 收盤資料。差異最大的三檔值得記住：健策 3653 推估 -0.5% → 實際 +7.96%（方向完全相反）、金像電 2368 推估 +2.5% → 實際 -3.07%（方向也相反）、緯創 3231 推估 -0.5% → 實際 +2.50%。★ 這是一個重要的自我校正：當推估與實際在同一天出現三次「方向相反」，代表那套推估邏輯（用大盤漲跌幅＋族群強弱去推個股）在族群內部分化大的日子裡基本上無效。以後這一區標「示意」的數字，請當成「只用來畫圖的填充值」，不要拿來做任何判斷。　③【記憶體這條線本週有硬催化劑】美光（MU）9/30 財報。你清單裡直接對到這條線的是南亞科 2408、華邦電 2344、旺宏 2337、力積電 6770 與美股的 MU（週一 -2.61%）。★ 多空對撞的兩邊沒變：空方是 CXMT 的產能與市佔推進，多方是 HBM 排擠一般型 DRAM 造成的結構性缺貨與合約價續漲。財報當天的重點不會是上一季數字，而是下一季的資本支出指引與 HBM 產能分配——那才是決定台灣記憶體族群定價的變數。

movers.name: ⚠️ 先說清楚這一區今天的資料基準
movers.price: 美股＝9/28（一）收盤・新資料｜台股＝9/24（四）收盤・第四次顯示
movers.reason: ★ 美股這一區今天全是新的：9/28 是一個「利率驅動的普跌日」，所以跌幅 5% 以上的名單特別長，而且集中在高估值成長股與晶片股。台股的部分仍是 9/24，因為 9/29（今天）13:30 才收盤——明天這一區就會換成今天的真實收盤資料。　【今天讀這一區的正確方式】不要一檔一檔看「為什麼跌」，先看「一起跌的是誰」。當 QCOM -7.17%、ARM -8.48%、INTC -5.67%、AMD -3.61%、MRVL -3.83% 同一天出現，而 NVDA 反而 +1.68%，這不是各家基本面同時轉壞，是資金在「殺估值」時連帶把整個族群掃到，只有最強的那一檔被留下。分辨「族群被掃」與「個股出事」，是這一區存在的主要理由。

movers.name: Kodiak Sciences（清單外 · 當日最大漲幅）
movers.price: 9/28 收盤 · 股價翻超過一倍
movers.reason: ★ 濕性年齡相關性黃斑部病變（wet AMD, age-related macular degeneration）三期臨床試驗結果正面，股價一天漲逾 1.5 倍。　【為什麼放在最上面】不是因為你該追，而是因為它示範了生技股的報酬結構：二元（binary）——三期成功或失敗，中間沒有灰階。這和你清單裡 LLY、NVO、AMGN 這種已有上市產品、現金流穩定的大藥廠完全不是同一種資產，雖然它們都被歸在「醫療」。★ 判斷框架：看到生技股單日翻倍，先問「是臨床數據還是併購傳聞」——臨床數據的漲幅通常留得住一部分，傳聞則常常隔天就還回去。

movers.name: MongoDB（清單外 · 當日最大跌幅）
movers.price: 9/28 收盤 · 單日腰斬五分之一
movers.reason: ★ 執行長離職，去 Meta 主持新的企業 AI 計畫。　【這則新聞的資訊量比股價大】它同時說明兩件事：① Meta 正在用「挖現任上市公司 CEO」的力度組建企業 AI 團隊，這是人才競爭白熱化的訊號（對照今天科技區 OpenAI 喊停 GPT-6.1 的新聞，兩者拼起來是一幅「前沿競賽正在重新洗牌」的圖）；② 資料庫／基礎設施類軟體公司的估值有多依賴單一領導人。　★ 對你的清單沒有直接持股影響，但 SNOW（雲端資料平台）是同一條賽道，當天 -2.33%。

movers.name: Qualcomm（你的清單內 · 跌幅最重）
movers.reason: ★★ 這是你 75 檔清單裡 9/28 跌最多的一檔，三個原因疊在一起：① 三星 2 奈米代工的定價與良率談判卡住，可能拖到 2027 年；② Snapdragon Summit 之後的行情動能退潮；③ 10 年期殖利率站上 5.22% 以上，整個晶片族群被掃。　【拆解一下第 ① 點對你的意義】高通把部分先進製程訂單分給三星，本來就是為了對台積電議價。談判卡住＝台積電的議價地位相對更強，這對 2330 是偏多的間接訊號，雖然當天台積電 ADR 沒有明顯反應。　★ 判斷框架：當一檔股票同時有「公司特定壞消息」與「整個族群都跌」，先看族群裡沒有壞消息的同業跌多少（AVGO -0.92%、NVDA +1.68%），差額才是市場真正給這則公司新聞的定價。這裡差額很大，代表三星那條消息是真的被當回事。

movers.name: Intel（你的清單內 · 跌逾 5%）
movers.reason: ★★ 你清單裡第二重的跌幅。原因是獲利了結加上族群氣氛轉弱——INTC 今年以來已漲約 214%，這種漲幅之下任何風吹草動都會引發停利；另有報導指 Apple 正在切斷剩餘的 Intel 舊有合作。　【必須提醒的一件事】你的 config/site.json 裡 INTC 的參考價還記著 89.51 美元，而實際已經 116.03——落後約 30%。這只影響 sparkline 的縱軸縮放、不影響漲跌幅，但落差到這個程度圖形已經會誤導。今天列在最後的 historyNote 有完整的校準清單。

movers.name: Meta（你的清單內 · 大型股中最重）
movers.reason: ★ 核心科技五檔裡跌最多的一檔（MSFT -1.35%、GOOGL -0.34%、AAPL -0.78%、AMZN -1.41%）。當天 Meta 同時是 MongoDB 執行長離職事件的「買方」——它在挖人組建企業 AI 團隊。　★ 這裡有一個值得記住的市場行為：市場對「大舉投資 AI」的反應已經從 2023–2024 年的獎勵，轉為 2026 年的懷疑——投資被解讀成資本支出上升、自由現金流下降。同一個動作，兩年前推升股價、現在壓低股價。這不是基本面改變，是敘事改變。

movers.name: 資安三檔逆勢走強（你的清單內）
